application_targets.label: SATISFIED
application_targets.exact_quote: Sh. Ramji Lal Goel and Sh. Bhajan Lal Goel got retired from the firm w.e.f. 01.04.1992 vide deed of dissolution dated 16.04.1992 and Sh. Surender Goel joined the firm with Sh. Naresh Goel.
application_targets.reason: The target court treated the 1992 retirement/change in the firm as established and then found parting with physical and legal possession; the relied conduct is therefore post-9-June-1952.

application_targets.label: UNRESOLVED
application_targets.reason: Although the section is discussed under a sub-letting heading, the target court's case-specific first-ingredient finding is expressly that physical and legal possession was parted with; it did not separately identify sub-letting as the factual route.

application_targets.label: UNRESOLVED
application_targets.reason: The target court did not independently find an assignment. The separate assignment alternative is not inferred from the general section 14(1)(b) conclusion.

application_targets.label: SATISFIED
application_targets.exact_quote: the physical as well as legal possession of the tenanted premises has been parted with.
application_targets.reason: The target court expressly found both physical and legal possession had been parted with.

application_targets.label: SATISFIED
application_targets.exact_quote: first ingredient of Sec. 14(1)(b) of D.R.C. Act is satisfied as the physical as well as legal possession of the tenanted premises has been parted with.
application_targets.reason: The statutory disjunction is satisfied through the expressly found parting-with-possession route; no finding is propagated to subletting or assignment.

application_targets.label: SATISFIED
application_targets.exact_quote: ingredient in respect of not taking of consent of landlord in writing is also satisfied.
application_targets.reason: The target court expressly held the negative written-consent element satisfied after finding no cogent and convincing evidence proving written consent from either the previous owner or the petitioners.

application_targets.label: DEFEATED
application_targets.exact_quote: Sh. Ramji Lal Goel and Sh. Bhajan Lal Goel got retired from the firm w.e.f. 01.04.1992
application_targets.reason: The target court's relied change and ensuing parting with possession are tied to 1992, so the supplied pre-9-June-1952 subletting exception has no factual trigger.

application_targets.label: DEFEATED
application_targets.exact_quote: Sh. Ramji Lal Goel was never authorised to operate the bank account of M/s Goel Handloom House.
application_targets.reason: The target court rejected the claimed continuing control and ultimately found divestment of both physical and legal possession. The retained-control qualification therefore does not negate parting with possession on the target court's facts.

issue_target.label: SUPPORTED
issue_target.exact_quote: I am of the considered view that the ingredients of 14(1)(b) D.R.C. Act are satisfied and consequently, an eviction order is passed in favour of the petitioners and against the respondents
issue_target.reason: The Additional Rent Controller expressly held the section 14(1)(b) ingredients satisfied and passed an eviction order.
issue_target.procedural_limit: ARC first-instance adjudication. The issue target reflects this trial-level application; separate statutory routes remain separately labeled rather than inferred from the overall conclusion.

The target court finds no cogent and convincing proof of written consent for the arrangement.
